lead_editorial.title: Arnab ke zakhm abhi bhare nahi, aur Murasu darwaze par — Andhra ke liye yeh taiyaari ki asli pariksha hai
lead_editorial.summary: Ek hafte mein do cyclone ek hi tat ko chhoo rahe hain. Jaan bachaane mein India ne lambi doori tay ki hai, ab zaroorat hai ki rahat aur punarnirmaan bhi utni hi tez ho.
body: Madhyamam ki report ke mutabik Cyclone Arnab ne 28 October ko Narsapur ke paas tat paar kiya tha, saat logon ki jaan gayi aur shuruaati nuksaan ka anumaan Rs 4,600 crore hai. Kendra ki team abhi nuksaan ka aakalan hi kar rahi hai ki IMD ne naye toofan Murasu ke usi ilaake — Nellore aur Narsapur ke beech — se guzarne ki chetavani de di hai. Yaani jo gaon, khet aur bijli ki lines abhi theek bhi nahi hui, unhe phir se jhatka lag sakta hai.

Pichhle do dashakon mein Odisha aur Andhra ne early warning aur samay par evacuation se maut ka aankda kaafi ghataaya hai — yeh sach mein rashtriya uplabdhi hai. Lekin cyclone ka asar sirf landfall ki raat tak seemit nahi rehta. Doosra toofan jab pehle se kamzor bandhon, adhoore marammat waale gharon aur bheegi fasalon par girta hai, to nuksaan jod nahi, guna mein badhta hai.

Isliye hamari raay mein do kaam turant hone chahiye. Pehla, Arnab ke prabhaavit parivaron ko di jaane waali rahat ko Murasu ke intezaar mein roka na jaaye — rahat camp, khaana aur dawa pehle se ilaakon mein pahunche. Doosra, Kendra aur rajya nuksaan ke aakalan ko 'do alag cyclone' ki file mein baantne ke bajaay ek saath dekhein, taaki kisaanon aur machhuaron ko muaavze ke liye do baar daftaron ke chakkar na kaatne padein.

Bay of Bengal mein October-November ka mausam hamesha se toofani raha hai, aur garam hote samudra ke saath yeh khatra kam nahi hone waala. Agar Murasu ke baad bhi hum har baar shuru se shuru karenge, to yeh mausam ki nahi, niti ki naakaami hogi. Aaj ki raat Andhra ke tat par prashasan ki chusti hi tay karegi ki yeh sirf ek aur toofan ki khabar bane, ya ek aur traasdi ki.

stories.title: Cyclone Murasu Bay of Bengal mein bana, Andhra tat par alert; IMD — Nellore aur Narsapur ke beech Somvaar raat ya Mangalvaar subah landfall sambhav
stories.summary: Arnab ke sirf paanch din baad naya toofan. IMD ke anumaan mein 100-110 kmph ki hawaayein, jhonke 120 kmph tak; Tamil Nadu aur Kerala ke kai zilon mein bhi baarish ka alert.
body: India Meteorological Department (IMD) ke Ravivaar dopahar ke bulletin ke hawaale se Madhyamam ne bataaya ki Bay of Bengal ka system cyclonic storm 'Murasu' ban gaya hai. Subah 11:30 baje yeh Chennai se kareeb 560 km poorv-dakshin-poorv aur Visakhapatnam se kareeb 660 km dakshin-dakshin-poorv mein tha. IMD ka anumaan hai ki Somvaar subah tak yeh severe cyclonic storm ban sakta hai aur uttar-pashchim ki taraf badhte hue Somvaar der raat ya Mangalvaar subah Andhra Pradesh ke dakshini tat par Nellore aur Narsapur ke beech paar kar sakta hai. Is dauraan hawa ki raftaar 100-110 kmph aur jhonke 120 kmph tak pahunch sakte hain.

The Week ki report ke mutabik Murasu naam India ne prastaavit kiya tha aur yeh is saal Bay of Bengal ka doosra cyclonic storm hai. Report mein South Coastal Andhra aur Rayalaseema ke kai hisson mein agle teen din madhyam se bhaari baarish ka anumaan diya gaya, jabki Tamil Nadu mein 1 se 6 November tak baarish aur Kerala ke kai zilon ke liye 4 November tak yellow alert ki baat kahi gayi hai.

Yeh toofan aise samay aa raha hai jab Cyclone Arnab ka asar abhi taaza hai — Madhyamam ke anusaar Arnab ne 28 October ko Narsapur ke paas tat paar kiya tha, jismein saat log maare gaye aur shuruaati nuksaan Rs 4,600 crore aanka gaya. Kendra ki ek team abhi bhi rajya mein us nuksaan ka aakalan kar rahi hai.

stories.title: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit ne sambhaali IAF ki kaman, bane 29ve Chief of the Air Staff; AP Singh chaar dashak ki sewa ke baad retire
stories.summary: Mirage-2000, Jaguar aur Tejas jaise vimaan uda chuke fighter pilot Dixit iske pehle Vice Chief the. Operation Sindoor samet kai abhiyaanon mein hissa le chuke hain.
body: The Pioneer ki report ke mutabik Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit ne Shanivaar, 31 October ko Bhartiya Vayu Sena ke 29ve Chief of the Air Staff ka padbhaar sambhaala. Unhone Air Chief Marshal Amar Preet Singh ki jagah li, jo usi din chaar dashak se zyada ki sewa ke baad retire hue. Dixit iske pehle Vice Chief of the Air Staff the, aur usse pehle Chief of Integrated Defence Staff tatha Central Air Command ke AOC-in-C reh chuke hain.

Report ke anusaar 6 December 1986 ko fighter stream mein commission paane waale Dixit ke paas 3,500 se zyada ghanton ka flying anubhav hai — Mirage-2000, MiG ke kai variants, Jaguar aur Tejas samet. Woh experimental test pilot aur qualified flying instructor bhi hain, aur Operations Safed Sagar, Rakshak aur Sindoor mein hissa le chuke hain. Unhe 2026 mein Param Vishisht Seva Medal mila tha.

image.alt: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit ki aadhikaarik tasveer

stories.title: Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Simhastha Kumbh ka aagaaz: Rashtrapati Murmu ne Ramkund par dhwaj fahraaya, CM Fadnavis ne Kushavarta mein kiya poojan
stories.summary: Godavari ke ghaaton par dhwajarohan ke saath mele ki shuruaat hui; samaaroh mein sant, dharmguru, neta aur hazaaron shraddhalu maujood the.
body: Free Press Journal ki report ke mutabik Rashtrapati Droupadi Murmu ne Shanivaar, 31 October ko Nashik mein Godavari ke Shri Ramkund ghaat par dhwajarohan karke Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Simhastha Kumbh Mela 2026 ki shuruaat ki. Usi din Maharashtra ke Mukhyamantri Devendra Fadnavis ne Trimbakeshwar ke Kushavarta Tirth par Sringeri Sharada Peeth ke Jagadguru Sri Sri Bharati Tirtha Mahaswamiji ki maujoodgi mein dhwaj fahraaya.

Report ke anusaar samaaroh mein sant-mahant, dharmik pratinidhi, kai vidhayak aur hazaaron shraddhalu shaamil hue. Simhastha har 12 saal mein Nashik aur Trimbakeshwar mein lagta hai, aur aane waale mahinon mein yahaan bhaari bheed ke prabandhan ki badi chunauti prashasan ke saamne hogi.

editorial.title: Naye Vayu Sena pramukh ke saamne sabse bada kaam — anubhav ko squadron ki sankhya mein badalna
body: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit ek aise fighter pilot hain jinke paas test pilot aur instructor dono ka anubhav hai, aur woh Operation Sindoor jaise haaliya abhiyaan ka hissa rahe hain. Yeh pratyaksh anubhav aaj ki Vayu Sena ke liye keemti hai, jahaan yuddh ki raftaar drones, missiles aur electronic warfare se tay ho rahi hai.

Hamari raay mein unke kaarykaal ki kasauti bhaashan nahi, delivery hogi — swadeshi vimaanon ka samay par shaamil hona, training aur maintenance ki kshamata, aur teenon senaon ke beech taalmel. Integrated Defence Staff mein kaam kar chuke pramukh se yeh ummeed karna galat nahi ki woh 'jointness' ko kaagaz se zameen par utaarenge.

stories.title: US midterms ek din door: national polls mein Democrats aage, par Senate ki ladaai Kansas, Michigan, Iowa jaise kaante ke muqablon par tiki
stories.summary: 435 House aur 35 Senate seaton par Mangalvaar ko voting. 51 million se zyada log pehle hi vote daal chuke; Trump ne Iowa aur Kansas mein rally ki yojana palti.
body: Al Jazeera ki report ke mutabik Mangalvaar, 3 November ko America mein House ki sabhi 435 aur Senate ki 35 seaton par chunaav hai. Dono sadanon mein bahumat ke liye Democrats ko House mein teen aur Senate mein chaar seaton ka net faayda chahiye. RealClearPolling ke average mein Democrats 51.5% aur Republicans 43.1% par hain; Emerson College ke 24-26 October ke survey mein Democrats ki rashtriya badhat 10 point ki thi. Vishleshak House mein Democrats ki jeet ki ummeed kar rahe hain, par Senate ka faisla alag-alag muqablon par nirbhar hai.

Sabse zyada nazar Kansas par hai, jahaan 1932 ke baad koi Democrat senator nahi chuna gaya. Washington Post-Schar School ke poll mein Democrat Adam Hamilton 52% aur Republican Sen. Roger Marshall 43% par hain, jabki Emerson ke poll mein antar sirf 50-47 ka hai. Michigan mein Democrat Abdul El-Sayed ka muqabla Republican Mike Rogers se hai. Republican strategist Doug Heye ne Kansas ki badi badhat par sawaal uthaaya, aur pollster Natalie Jackson ne kaha ki polls Republicans ko kam aank rahe ho sakte hain.

Report ke anusaar President Trump ne Iowa aur Kansas ki raliyaan pehle radd ki thi, phir Shukravaar ko faisla palatkar Ravivaar ko wahaan jaane ka elaan kiya. Mehngaai aur jeevan-yaapan ka kharch chunaav ka sabse bada mudda hai; 51 million se zyada Americans early voting kar chuke hain.

stories.title: US ne Ukraine ko 500 Patriot PAC-3 missiles ki $2.1 billion ki bikri manzoor ki, par delivery 2030s mein; Kremlin bola — Putin 10 November ke baad baatcheet ko 'siddhaant roop se' taiyaar
stories.summary: Kharch Canada, Germany, Norway aur EU loan se. Ukraine mein kadaake ki thand ke beech bijli ghanton gul; DTEK pramukh ne 'energy ceasefire' ki maang ki.
body: Reuters ki report (The Star mein prakashit) ke mutabik US State Department ne Shukravaar, 30 October ko Ukraine ko 500 Patriot PAC-3 missiles ki sambhaavit bikri ko manzoori di, jiski anumaanit keemat $2.1 billion hai. Ukraine iska bhugtaan Canada, Germany aur Norway ke yogdaan aur European Union ke Ukraine Support Loan se karega; mukhya contractor Lockheed Martin hai. Report mein do jaankaar logon ke hawaale se kaha gaya ki ye missiles abhi bani nahi hain aur 2030s ke shuruaati saalon se pehle delivery ki ummeed nahi hai, isliye Kyiv Pentagon se maujooda stock se missiles dene ki maang kar raha hai.

Kootneeti ke morche par Russia Analyzed ke saaptahik round-up ke mutabik Kremlin salahkaar Yuri Ushakov ne kaha ki Putin 10 November ke baad US-Ukraine-Russia trilateral baatcheet dobara shuru karne par 'siddhaant roop se' raazi hain. Isi round-up ke anusaar Ukraine ki urja company DTEK ke CEO Maksym Timchenko ne kaha ki minus 15 se minus 20 degree ki thand mein kai jagah 3-4 ghante bijli ke baad 10-15 ghante ki katauti ho rahi hai, aur unhone urja dhaanche par hamle rokne ke liye 'energy ceasefire' ki maang ki. Russia ka kehna hai ki woh sainya aur sena se jude urja dhaanche ko nishaana banata hai.

stories.title: DR Congo mein Ebola se maut ka aankda 5,000 ke paar, sankraman 10,351; Somalia ke paas samudri luteron ne 23 logon waala Iranian jahaaz hijack kiya
stories.summary: Sarkaari data ke mutabik mrityu dar kareeb 50%; Kenya, Nigeria aur Uganda mein bhi case. Hijack hua jahaaz commercial shipping lane ke paas.
body: Morning Star ke 'World in brief' ke mutabik DR Congo ke Shanivaar ko jaari sarkaari aankdon mein Ebola se 10,351 sankramit logon mein se 5,026 ki maut darj hui hai — yaani lagbhag 50% ki mrityu dar. Report ke anusaar Kenya, Nigeria aur Uganda mein bhi case saamne aaye hain, jo is prakop ke failaav ko lekar chinta badhaata hai.

Isi round-up ke anusaar Somalia ke paas samudri luteron ne Iran ke machhli pakadne waale jahaaz 'Azini' ko 23 logon samet Guruvaar ko Bandar Bayla aur Hafun ke beech kabze mein le liya. Maritime Security Centre Indian Ocean ne chetavani di ki jahaaz ek commercial shipping lane ke paas hai aur aage ke hamlon ke liye 'base' ki tarah istemaal ho sakta hai — Arabian Sea mein gasht karne waali Bhartiya Navy ke liye bhi yeh dhyaan dene waali khabar hai.

image.alt: Electron microscope se dikhta Ebola virus (file image)

editorial.title: 2030s mein aane waali missiles aaj ki thand mein Ukraine ko nahi bachaayengi — kootneeti ko hi raasta nikaalna hoga
body: $2.1 billion ki Patriot deal kaagaz par badi lagti hai, lekin jab missiles ki delivery saalon door ho, to yeh suraksha se zyada sanket hai. Ukraine ki asli musibat abhi ki hai — kadaake ki thand mein ghanton bijli gul aur gas dhaanche par hamle.

Hamari raay mein 10 November ke baad prastaavit baatcheet ka pehla agenda urja dhaanche par hamlon ki rok hona chahiye, jaisa DTEK pramukh ne bhi kaha. Yeh kisi ek paksh ki jeet-haar ka sawaal nahi, aam nagrikon ko sardi se bachaane ka nyuntam maanviya kadam hai. Aur America ke midterms ke baad Washington ki prathmiktaayein jo bhi hon, hathiyaar ki deal aur shaanti ki koshish saath-saath chalni chahiye.

stories.title: PM Modi aaj Bharat Mandapam mein Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo ka udghaatan karenge; 130 se zyada deshon ke pratinidhi, ISA Assembly aur Green Hydrogen conference bhi saath
stories.summary: Chaar din ka aayojan 2-5 November tak; theme 'Invest. Innovate. Inspire.' Mantri Pralhad Joshi ke mutabik India jald 300 GW non-fossil capacity paar karega.
body: UNI ki report ke mutabik PMO ne Ravivaar ko bataaya ki Prime Minister Narendra Modi Somvaar shaam kareeb 4:30 baje New Delhi ke Bharat Mandapam mein Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 2026 ka udghaatan karenge aur sabha ko sambodhit karenge. 2 se 5 November tak chalne waale is aayojan mein 130 se zyada deshon ki sarkaarein, global niveshak, technology providers aur industry leaders shaamil honge; iska theme 'Invest. Innovate. Inspire.' hai.

GreenTechLead ki report ke anusaar yeh aayojan teen kaaryakramon ko ek saath laata hai — BRE Summit & Expo, International Solar Alliance (ISA) Assembly ka 9va session aur Green Hydrogen par 4th International Conference. Curtain raiser mein Kendriya Mantri Pralhad Joshi ne kaha tha ki India jald hi 300 GW ki installed non-fossil bijli kshamata paar kar lega aur PM Surya Ghar yojana ke laabharthi gharon ki sankhya 50 lakh ke paar jaane ki ummeed hai. Focus battery storage, floating solar, agrivoltaics aur National Green Hydrogen Mission par rahega.

stories.title: IDBI Bank ke karmchaariyon aur adhikaariyon ki aaj se do din ki deshvyaapi bhookh hadtaal; Fairfax ko bikri ke prastaav ka virodh
stories.summary: UFIOE ki maang — sarkaar 51% hissedari banaaye rakhe. Union ne baatcheet ki tatparta jataai, par anishchitkaalin hadtaal ki chetavani bhi di.
body: Free Press Journal ki report ke mutabik United Forum of IDBI Officers and Employees (UFIOE) ne 2 aur 3 November ko bank ki shaakhaon aur daftaron mein deshvyaapi bhookh hadtaal ka elaan kiya hai. Union Canada sthit Fairfax Financial Holdings ko IDBI Bank bechne ke prastaav ka virodh kar rahi hai, jisse sarkaar aur LIC ki hissedari ghategi aur prabandhan Fairfax ke haath mein jaayega. Union ka tark hai ki bank vittiya roop se ubhar chuka hai aur 2003 mein Sansad mein sarkaari bahumat hissedari ka aashwaasan diya gaya tha.

Union chaahti hai ki sarkaar LIC ya bazaar se kam se kam 6% aur hissedari kharidkar 51% bahumat banaaye rakhe, saath hi service sharton, pension aur aarakshan neeti par likhit gaaranti de. Dainik Jagran ke mutabik United Forum of Bank Unions ne bhi is andolan ka samarthan kiya hai. Report mein graahak sewaon par asar ki koi jaankari nahi di gayi hai.

editorial.title: 300 GW ka aankda jashn ke laayak hai, par agla padaav storage aur grid ka hai
body: Saaf urja mein India ki tezi se badhti kshamata ek asli uplabdhi hai, aur 130 se zyada deshon ko Delhi bulana dikhata hai ki duniya is bazaar ko gambhirta se le rahi hai. Lekin installed capacity aur bharosemand bijli ek baat nahi — solar din mein aata hai, maang shaam ko chadhti hai.

Hamari raay mein is summit ki safalta MoU ki ginti se nahi, battery storage aur transmission mein aane waale thos nivesh se aanki jaani chahiye. Rooftop solar ka 50 lakh gharon tak pahunchna achha sanket hai; ab zaroorat hai ki discoms ki vittiya sehat aur grid ki kshamata bhi isi raftaar se sudhre.

stories.title: Mexico City GP mein Verstappen ki jeet, teesre sthaan par rehkar 20 saal ke Kimi Antonelli bane F1 itihaas ke sabse kam umra ke world champion
stories.summary: Hamilton doosre, Leclerc ko pehle lap ki takkar par 5 second ki penalty; Russell par bhi 10 second ka dand. Agla race São Paulo mein 6-8 November.
body: Formula 1 ki aadhikaarik website ke mutabik Ravivaar, 1 November ko Mexico City ke Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez mein 71 lap ki race Red Bull ke Max Verstappen ne paanchve grid sthaan se shuru karke jeeti. Ferrari ke Lewis Hamilton ek second se kam ke antar se doosre rahe, aur Mercedes ke Kimi Antonelli teesre. Antonelli ko title ke liye sirf nauve sthaan tak finish karna tha — podium ke saath hi 20 saal ke Italian driver ne apna pehla title pakka kiya aur sabse kam umra ke F1 World Champion ban gaye.

Race ki shuruaat mein Ferrari ke dono drivers Turn 1 aur Turn 4 mein saath-saath track se bahar gaye; Leclerc grass ke raaste aage nikle aur baad mein unhe 5 second ki penalty mili. Report ke anusaar Hamilton ne radio par stewards ki aalochana ki. Mercedes ke George Russell ko pehle lap par Isack Hadjar ko spin karaane ke liye 10 second ki penalty mili aur woh chhathe sthaan par rahe. Season ka agla padaav São Paulo Grand Prix hai.

stories.title: Shah Rukh Khan ka aaj janmdin: reports ke mutabik 'King' ka teaser aaj aane ki ummeed; Siddharth Anand ki film 24 December ko release
stories.summary: Film mein Suhana Khan ka bade parde par debut, saath mein Rani Mukerji, Abhishek Bachchan, Deepika Padukone aur Anil Kapoor. Makers ki taraf se teaser ki aadhikaarik pushti report mein nahi.
body: WION ki report ke mutabik Shah Rukh Khan ke janmdin, 2 November ko unki agli film 'King' ka teaser aane waala hai, jisse film ka global marketing abhiyaan shuru hoga. Report Bollywood Hungama ke hawaale se teaser cut ki tareef karti hai, lekin makers ka koi aadhikaarik bayaan usmein nahi diya gaya hai. Film 24 December 2026 ko theatres mein release hogi aur iska nirdeshan 'Pathaan' banaane waale Siddharth Anand kar rahe hain.

Report ke anusaar film mein Suhana Khan bade parde par debut kar rahi hain, aur Rani Mukerji, Abhishek Bachchan, Deepika Padukone, Anil Kapoor tatha Raghav Juyal ahem kirdaaron mein hain. Film Red Chillies Entertainment aur Marflix ka production hai.

editorial.title: 20 saal ka champion batata hai ki F1 mein naye daur ki shuruaat ho chuki hai
body: Kimi Antonelli ka title sirf ek record nahi, Mercedes ke us faisle ki jeet bhi hai jisne ek kishore driver par bharosa kiya. Mexico mein unhone jokhim lene ke bajaay samajhdaari se podium liya — champion wahi hota hai jo zaroorat ke hisaab se race chalaaye.

Saath hi Verstappen ki jeet aur Hamilton ka podium yaad dilaate hain ki purane sitaare abhi haar maanne waale nahi. Hamari raay mein agle season ki sabse dilchasp kahaani yahi hogi ki kya yuva Antonelli dabaav mein bhi apni raftaar banaaye rakh paate hain.
